$comment: Sites that splice the `https://jmrp.io/#person` node into their own @graph.
All of them read the canonical document from raw.githubusercontent at build
time and keep `snapshotPath` as an offline fallback;
scripts/ci/propagate-identity.mjs rewrites it when the canonical changes.
`dispatchWorkflow` is that repo's docs build. After committing a snapshot
the script reads the workflow's own `on.push` filter: when it covers the
snapshot path the commit starts the build, otherwise the script dispatches
it. A declared prefix used to stand in for that check and was wrong for
cs-routeros-bouncer, whose site kept an old #person for two weeks.
A consumer may be listed before its repository is public: the script
reports it as `not published` and moves on, so the entry is already there
Adding a consumer is adding an entry here.
